data.action: 海滨贩卖机前比较冷饮性价比，坐到海堤边贴脸降温并偷偷得意
data.description: 【海滨商业街·午后】圭穿着蓝灰色泳装外搭轻薄风衣，蹲在自动贩卖机前认真比较两种冷饮；她最终选择最划算的一瓶，坐到海堤边把罐子贴在脸上，蓝眼睛里藏着小小的得意。
data.lighting: warm afternoon light with cool can highlights
data.promptProse: After carefully comparing the seaside vending-machine drinks, Kei Shirogane sits on the seawall and presses her chosen cold can to her cheek. A light windbreaker covers her slate-blue swimsuit, black headband holding her hair as blue eyes show modest triumph. The horizontal medium view includes the vending machine behind and sea below the wall. Warm afternoon sun lights the jacket folds, while the chilled metal carries a cooler sharp highlight beside her face.
data.title: 白银圭 · 海边自动贩卖机的冷饮选择
